'''Berr Irichmin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3642 BBY]], he resided on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and was in the last stand the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] made in [[Olaris]], until he was defeated by an Imperial individual.

==Behind the scenes==
Berr Irichmin appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Taris. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed by any Imperial character as part of the achievement "Tyrant of Taris". This articles assumes 100% game completion, which means Berr Irichmin was killed.
